g.text: Wonton POS - Final V3 Domain Class Diagram
Scope: UC-01..UC-26 (Dine-in / Takeaway / Pickup; Delivery out of scope)
This diagram is a domain class diagram, not a physical ERD.
It keeps the SQL schema's main concepts but groups them by business
responsibility and includes domain operations implied by the 26 UCs.
Core aggregate for UC-01, UC-03, UC-09,
kitchen release; Dine-in may remain unpaid
UC-22 86d is a temporary availability flag.
It is independent from StockAdjustment and
promotions only. Free-item and BOGO promotions
UC-21 reconciliation includes cash, bank-transfer QR,
online gateway, refunds, write-off, comp, forfeited,
Operational actor links are intentionally summarized
through AuditLog to keep the class diagram readable.
Staff IDs still exist on SQL records such as payments,
refunds, complaints, shifts, availability events, and
Guest checkout is represented on Order by guestName
and guestPhone, not by a separate GuestAccount class.
Guest tracking uses Order Code + Phone Number.
